title: Compute Has Shape: Self-Morphing the Internal Computation of Frozen LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.38382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time scaling improves large language models through additional computation, but how to adapt the topology of internal computation to individual inputs remains underexplored. Existing approaches largely fix recurrent or parallel architectures during training, or reconfigure frozen models along a single structural axis. We introduce SelfMorph, which makes computational shape an input-dependent inference-time decision. It unifies the original forward path (BASE), serial reuse of a layer span (REPEAT), and local branching and merging of perturbed hidden states (BRANCH) in a unified space parameterized by type, location, and intensity. Since they offer complementary benefits rather than uniform dominance, we use a lightweight selector that reads the backbone's depth-wise hidden state trajectory on the prompt to choose a morphology before response generation. We train the selector by distilling utility-based distribution from offline morp

translated_title: 计算具有形状：自变形冻结大语言模型的内部计算
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展通过额外的计算来提升大语言模型的性能，但如何根据具体输入调整内部计算的拓扑结构仍然鲜有探索。现有方法大多在训练期间固定循环或并行架构，或仅沿单一结构轴对冻结模型进行重新配置。我们提出了SelfMorph，使计算形状成为依赖于输入的推理时决策。它将原始前向路径（BASE）、层区间的串行复用（REPEAT）以及扰动隐状态的局部分支与合并（BRANCH）统一在一个由类型、位置和强度参数化的空间中。由于这些模式提供的是互补收益而非某一模式的全面优势，我们使用一个轻量级选择器，在生成响应之前读取主干模型在提示词上沿深度的隐状态轨迹，以选择一种计算形态。我们通过从离线变形中蒸馏基于效用的分布来训练该选择器（原文摘要至此被截断）。
tldr: 提出SelfMorph框架，让冻结的大语言模型在推理时根据输入自主选择计算形态（原始前向、层区间复用或分支合并），实现内部计算拓扑的自适应变形。
en_tdlr: SelfMorph enables frozen LLMs to autonomously choose their computational morphology (base forward, layer-span reuse, or branch-merge) at inference time based on each input, adaptively reshaping the internal computation topology.
